description: She wears a floor-length dark forest-green textured gown with a fitted bodice and low square neckline. Gold knotwork borders decorate the neckline, sleeves, vertical front bands and hem. Sleeves end near the elbows. A broad green, brown and ochre checked shawl with knotwork edging drapes around her forearms, held by a round decorated brooch near one shoulder. A narrow brown and gold belt with round metal ornament secures the waist. An ivory underdress shows at the front opening above brown leather shoes. A small pendant and green-stone ring add jewelry. No headgear or weapons are present.
